name: Rust
description: Rust through rustup: a toolchain (default stable) with clippy and rustfmt, more targets on request, and gcc to link with.

toolchain.description: The default toolchain: a channel (stable, beta, nightly) or a release like 1.91.0.

components.description: Components to add to the toolchain, comma-separated, e.g. clippy,rustfmt,rust-src.

targets.description: More targets to install, comma-separated, e.g. wasm32-unknown-unknown,aarch64-unknown-linux-musl.

bottle.context: Rust's `${toolchain}` toolchain is installed through rustup (`cargo`, `rustc`, `rustup`), components ${components}; `rustup` can add more without sudo. `cargo install` puts programs in `~/.cargo/bin`, on login shells' PATH.
